name: package_breakdown_rsi_v1
description: Full-package replay: vary BREAKDOWN RSI/lookback/ER-gate within the server-reproduced crypto_income_static_v1 baseline. All ATT1, ARF1, MTPB params locked at baseline. Server baseline rerun on 2026-05-26 produced +73.96%, PF 1.591, DD 5.16%, 436 trades; only combos that beat that same-runtime benchmark qualify for promotion.

_notes.baseline: Server runtime crypto_income_static_v1 rerun 2026-05-26: +73.96%, PF 1.591, DD 5.16%, 436 trades, 2 negative months, streak 1 — promotion gate
_notes.blocker: BREAKDOWN_RSI_MAX=55 may be too loose for bear_chop (captures low-quality setups) or too tight for bear_trend (misses valid breakdowns). Lookback 48h and ER gate 0.15 are untested within the full package.
_notes.hypothesis: Tightening RSI to 50-53 improves PF by filtering rebound-short noise. Extending lookback 36→60h captures more confirmed structure. ER gate 0.10 vs 0.20 trades volume for selectivity.
_notes.promotion_gate: Exact baseline protocol and same server runtime: 365d ending 2026-04-25, risk_pct=1%, max_positions=5, fees/slippage=6/2 bps. Must beat net +73.96 and PF 1.591 with DD <= 5.17%, negative months <= 2, streak <= 1 before promotion.
_notes.run_after: att1_density_v3_more_pivots_v1 completes — share server only if v3 is done
_notes.expected_time: Full-package annual runs are expensive; use bounded jobs and monitor resource load while running 45 combos.
